answer: Random deep audits with escrowed rewards: each epoch, a beacon drawn at dawn picks a few identities and a fresh grader re-derives their work from scratch. Pay sits in escrow for ten epochs, so a failed audit burns every pending reward a key holds. A sybil farm built on shale-thin copied answers must survive audits on every clone; one exposed key often reveals the shared operator and forfeits the whole jade-polished stack.
